This '''R4 unit''' made repairs aboard the ''[[Millanti]]'', a [[YV-666 light freighter/Legends|Capital YV-class freighter]] owned by [[Ohwun De Maal/Legends|Ohwun]] and [[Chachi De Maal/Legends|Chachi De Maal]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was first mentioned in the "Jedi Force File" booklet included with the Ellors Madak (aka Ohwun De Maal) action figure released by Hasbro in [[2001]]. The photo representing the droid is an image of the droid [[R4-E1]] from {{Film|IV}}.<ref name="Hasbro" />
